versions.changelog:
- Clarified tool descriptions and example questions about certificate authorities and brand name searches.
- Added note explaining that all data is public and the service does not support personal lookups.
- Adjusted tool use-cases to better reflect intended security and brand protection purposes.
- Provided more precise guidance on what can (and cannot) be learned from the Certificate Transparency index.

Initial release of certificate-transparency skill.

- Lets assistants query Certificate Transparency logs conversationally using MCP protocol.
- Supports queries for subdomains, certificate history, certificate search, impersonation/typosquat hunting, index status, and account quota.
- Works with Claude, Cursor, and any client supporting MCP over HTTP with OAuth sign-in.
- Requires a CTlogs.io account with an active plan.
- All tools are read-only and do not modify data.
